subject: Discovery recap + request: VP/CTO intro to align on infra & SLOs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.com>, Diego Ramirez <diego.ramirez@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + request: VP/CTO intro to align on infra & SLOs

Hi Sofia + Diego — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and to capture next steps: 

Goals we heard
- Reduce inference latency for customer-facing features to <200ms p95
- Lower per-token serving cost by 30% on average via batching/quantization
- Ensure data residency and auditability for user content (EU region is required for a portion of traffic)

Current infra notes you shared
- Primary product on AWS us-west-2, some EU traffic routed via EU account
- In-house model orchestration, no SLAs for inference today

Key constraints
- Procurement window: Q2 renewal for existing vendor (end of April)
- Security: SOC2 + limited vendor onboarding window for infra changes

Proposed next steps
1) Executive alignment call (30 min) with your VP/CTO to confirm success criteria and procurement cadence — this will unblock a technical deep-dive/demo with our infra/eng team.
2) Technical deep-dive/demo (60 min) with engineering — proposed after exec alignment.

Do you have availability for a 30-minute exec sync next week? If helpful, I can loop in our VP of Engineering, Vivek Kulkarni, and Rishi (sales lead) so both sides are represented. I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a SOC2 summary for review.

Thanks — happy to align calendars.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
https://redwood.com

Attachments: MAP-ACME-v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: Diego Ramirez <diego.ramirez@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + request: VP/CTO intro to align on infra & SLOs

Thanks Marissa — great writeup and aligns with what we discussed. Sofia and I reviewed the MAP and SOC2 summary. A few quick notes: 
- The <200ms p95 is aggressive but aligns with our product goals; procurement will need clear unit economics.
- EU data residency is a hard requirement for Product B.

Sofia is the VP of Engineering who owns the procurement timeline and technical signoff; she’ll need to be on the exec call. She’s available next week on Tue 3/21 between 10:00-11:30 PT or Wed 3/22 14:00-16:00 PT.

Can you include Vivek from your side so we can make sure this is an exec-level alignment rather than a product-only discussion? Also please confirm if the technical deep-dive will include cost modeling (we’ll want the cost per 1M tokens for the recommended config).

— Diego
Diego Ramirez
Director, Platform Engineering — Acme Corp
diego.ramirez@acme.com

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:

Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + request: VP/CTO intro to align on infra & SLOs

Perfect — thanks Diego. Vivek and Rishi are looped in. Vivek, brief context: Acme (Sofia + Diego) are evaluating options ahead of a vendor renewal. They need exec alignment on success metrics (latency p95, cost targets) and confirmation on EU data residency before a full technical deep-dive.

Proposed 30-minute windows that match Sofia’s availability:
- Tue 2028-03-21 10:30-11:00 PT
- Tue 2028-03-21 11:00-11:30 PT
- Wed 2028-03-22 14:30-15:00 PT

If none of those work, happy to follow your calendar — here’s my Calendly if easier: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

Next item for the technical deep-dive: Vivek, if possible please come prepared to:
- Briefly outline high-level architecture for production inference (runtime, caching, quantization options)
- Share expected cost envelope for a 1M token workload under recommended config
- Confirm compatibility with EU data residency approaches (region pinning, customer-managed keys)

Attachments: MAP-ACME-v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

— Marissa

From: Diego Ramirez <diego.ramirez@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + request: VP/CTO intro to align on infra & SLOs

Thanks all — Tue 3/21 11:00-11:30 PT works for Sofia and me. Please send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link. We’ll expect a 30-minute exec-level sync followed by scheduling the 60-minute technical deep-dive (suggested window the following week).

Also: we’ll share a short procurement timeline doc prior to the exec call so you have context on deadlines.

Diego
Director, Platform Engineering — Acme Corp
